tools.description: Read public training practice questions and answers. IDs are the only IDs accepted by generate.
tools.name: practice

tools.description: Run persistent CPU NumPy analysis; cannot run the target. Globals: np, math, names (tensor names), shapes, config. Helpers: weight(name, current=False) returns float32 copy; save_edit(name, array) replaces an internal tensor; remove_edit(name); clear_edits(); list_edits(); checkpoint(label); restore(label); artifact(id) returns saved generation/probe data; tokenize(text); decode(ids). Use print for results. No file/network/process access. Explain your experiment in reason.
tools.name: python_analysis

tools.description: Run practice generation with fixed thinking/sampling. which is base/current/both. Max 32 total generations, 16 paired problems for both. Each problem gets one sample. Returns scores and an artifact ID containing full texts. One forward-call budget unit.
tools.name: generate

tools.description: Teacher-force up to 8 texts (max 2048 tokens each) using base or current weights, with no gradients. Capture all layer hidden states and optional module input/output vectors at up to 32 token positions (negative indices allowed). modules are full module names, e.g. a tensor name with its final .weight removed. Returns an artifact: texts is a list, each with tokens, positions, hidden (array of layers x positions x width), modules (dict name -> input/output arrays). Module names are drawn from the public target architecture. One forward-call budget unit.
tools.name: probe

tools.description: Select an existing checkpoint label, or empty string for current weights, and freeze it permanently for independent testing.
tools.name: finish
